messages:
marie: opening a quick PR: sealed-site migration cheat sheet. goal: one-page summary for networking + KMS->HSM migration + minimum RBAC sample + proxy-chaining debug tips. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9921 :wave:
emily: nice. can you add a tiny service-account YAML for the installer with least privileges? our last example gave cluster-admin by accident.
marie: yup planning this minimal SA: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: redwood-installer
  namespace: infra
---
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: redwood-installer-role
  namespace: infra
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "services", "configmaps"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "patch"]
```
(added comments about scoping to a dedicated namespace)
raj: for HSM migration section: call out that the PKCS11 PIN should be provided interactively at rotate time and never baked into the installer. include an example `pkcs11-tool` check and an operator prompt flow.
marie: added operator flow and this quick CLI health check for KMS endpoint: `curl -x http://proxy.local:3128 -I https://kms.svc:443/healthz` and a fallback `nc -vz kms.svc 443` for raw TCP check.
emily: also useful to show what to inspect when NAT/port-translation is happening — i.e., mismatched TLS SNI vs Host header. one-liner idea: `openssl s_client -connect proxy:8443 -servername kms.svc`
marie: good call, adding that under troubleshooting. also included a short note: "when using layered proxies, ensure X-Forwarded-For and SNI passthrough preserved".
docs-bot: @marie you can include reusable snippets via `docs/snippets/` and the `include_snippet` directive. lint will catch YAML formatting issues. docs CI: snippet-lint, linkcheck.
raj: lgtm. small nit: in the proxy-chain example the SDK parser accepts comma as delimiter (not semicolon). make sure examples match runtime.
marie: fixed both node & python examples to use commas. node sample: ```bash
export REDFLOW_PROXY_CHAIN="http://proxy1:3128,http://edgeproxy:8080"
node -e "require('redwood-sdk').Client().health().then(console.log)"
```
python sample: ```py
import os
from redwood_sdk import Client
os.environ['REDFLOW_PROXY_CHAIN'] = 'http://proxy1:3128,http://edgeproxy:8080'
client = Client()
print(client.health.check())
```
emily: can we have a tiny ascii diagram? helps non-technical readers.
marie: added ascii diagram under "quick flow":
```
client -> proxyA -> proxyB -> internal-kms -> hsm
```
caption: "Request path in a sealed-site with chained proxies."
docs-bot: staged preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/changes/9921 (expires 48h). CI: all checks passed except a small snippet-lint warning.
deploy-bot: FYI scheduled rollout of the docs update to preview site (tokenized access) :rocket:
emily: reviewed and approved. raj: approved.
marie: merging after I squash the tiny lint fix. thanks folks! :shipit:
